verdict.rationale: Running headlessly or in CI is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only desktop GUI features plus container tooling on the desktop. The Container_Toolbox and WSL artifacts are separate Fedora deliverables, not documented headless or CI operation of Workstation itself. A community report of running Workstation on a home media server with Cockpit is not headless or CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
